style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: SHE flies the frame edge to edge in EVERY beat, talking ones too; the rail, hangers and wall streak behind HER in EVERY beat; SHE fills half the frame height; camera rides beside HER low and level, moving in every beat, never on a schedule, new shot size each beat; one clear action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth, powdery wings, feathered antennae, round belly, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a green clerk visor darting ahead at lens all clip, never still; A SWARM of moths streaming along the rail with a dry flutter in every beat
props: ONE long receipt tape trailing from her hind leg; TWO mink coats on a steel rail, the first already chewed through; ONE red-stamped bill; ONE brass hanger; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: THE TAPE flies with her in every beat, never parked; the red bill stays swallowed until 9.35; the second mink hangs untouched until 7.3
environment: a sun-flooded walk-in wardrobe, a steel rail of fur coats, white walls, hard noon sun

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, deadpan, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA, GLO-zhut, sche-TA, dol-GHI, TAK-zhe, PA-ra, shub, NOR-ki, poch-TI, do-YE-la
audio.pacing: 0.7-4.6 one breath; pause 4.6-5.2; 5.2-7.3 one breath; after 7.3 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: dry wing flutter in every beat, fur ripping, the tape snapping, hangers ringing, one small burp at 9.45

timeline.a: she blasts out through a chewed hole in the first mink right at the lens, fur fluff bursting, and tears off right, THE TAPE snapping behind her
she rips right to left across the whole frame along the rail, hangers streaking past, CLERK darting ahead at lens
she banks and tears left to right edge to edge, THE TAPE whipping after her, THE SWARM streaming with it
she hooks a swinging sleeve and slings herself right to left along the rail, the rail streaking behind her
she tears left to right past both minks and they swing hard in her wake
she whips right to left back across the frame at the lens, THE TAPE cracking after her
CLERK slaps a red-stamped bill onto THE TAPE at lens, and both are dragged right to left off frame
she tears left to right edge to edge, fur fluff blasting off her wings
she banks hard right to left straight at the lens
she rips left to right past the second mink, THE SWARM tearing across after her
she bites the second mink on the fly and rips a long strip off it right to left, the coat spinning on its hanger
she tears THE TAPE off her leg on the fly and flings it left to right off frame, bills flapping
she rips the last of the mink off at lens and swallows the strip whole on the fly, the bare hanger spinning behind her
she hangs at the lens, burps a puff of fur fluff, and ONE red-stamped bill slides out of her mouth and dangles like a tongue, face to camera

must_appear: at 8.7 the mink is ripped off and the bare hanger spins; at 9.35 she burps fur fluff at the lens and ONE red-stamped bill slides out of her mouth and hangs there, face to camera
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, a prop worked in place, slow motion, a glowing emblem, a logo, human hands, speech after 7.3
